```yaml
name: Debug Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches: ['*']

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Print environment variables
        run: |
          echo "=== Environment Variables ==="
          printenv

      - name: Print Git configuration
        run: |
          echo "=== Git Configuration ==="
          git config --list

      - name: Check authentication status
        run: |
          echo "=== Authentication Status ==="
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is NOT set"
          else
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is set"
          fi
          echo "Git user.email: $(git config user.email || echo 'not set')"
          echo "Git user.name: $(git config user.name || echo 'not set')"

      - name: Fetch branch protection rules
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          echo "=== Branch Protection Rules ==="
          echo "Fetching protection for branch: $BRANCH"
          OWNER=$(echo "$REPO" | cut -d'/' -f1)
          REPO_NAME=$(echo "$REPO" | cut -d'/' -f2)
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$OWNER/$REPO_NAME/branches/$BRANCH/protection")
          if echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "$RESPONSE" | jq .
          else
            echo "No protection rules found for branch $BRANCH (HTTP 404 or empty response)."
          fi
```
